title: Curtis LeMay gave D. Harold Byrd a Civil Air Patrol award

tellings.quote: Curtis Lame gave him an award for the Civil Airore when he was younger.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Curtis LeMay, a top US Air Force general, gave a Texas businessman named D. Harold Byrd an award from the Civil Air Patrol, a volunteer civilian group that helps the Air Force, when Byrd was younger. He mentions it while discussing President Kennedy's killing and links to President Lyndon Johnson, as a sign of close ties between these powerful men.
